([[New Orleans|New Orleans, Louisiana]]) | college = * [[Southern Miss Golden Eagles basketball|Southern Miss]] (2020–2022) * [[Wichita State Shockers men's basketball|Wichita State]] (2022–2023) * [[Jacksonville State Gamecocks men's basketball|Jacksonville State]] (2024–2025) * [[SMU Mustangs men's basketball|SMU]] (2025–2026) | highlights = * [[Conference USA Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Conference USA Player of the Year]] (2025) * First-team All-[[Conference USA]] (2025) }} '''Jaron Pierre Jr.''' (born July 12, 2002) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[SMU Mustangs men's basketball|SMU Mustangs]] of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC). He previously played for the [[Southern Miss Golden Eagles basketball|Southern Miss Golden Eagles]], [[Wichita State Shockers men's basketball|Wichita State Shockers]], and [[Jacksonville State Gamecocks men's basketball|Jacksonville State Gamecocks]]. == Career == Pierre attended [[St. Augustine High School (New Orleans)|St. Augustine High School]] in [[New Orleans|New Orleans, Louisiana]]. After his high school career, he committed to play college basketball at [[University of Southern Mississippi]].{{Cite web |last=Staff |first=C. C. S. |date=2020-04-16 |title=Recruiting: St. Augustine guard Jaron Pierre signs with Southern Miss basketball |url=https://crescentcitysports.com/recruiting-st-augustine-guard-jaron-pierre-signs-with-southern-miss-basketball/ |access-date=2025-03-10 |website=Crescent City Sports |language=en-US}} Pierre played two seasons with the Golden Eagles, averaging 8.8 points as a true freshman and 9.9 points as a sophomore.{{Cite web |last=Eldridge |first=Taylor |title=How Jaron Pierre Jr. plans to become a 'smarter' scorer for Wichita State basketball |url=https://www.kansas.com/sports/college/wichita-state/article266410346.html |website=Wichita Eagle}} At the conclusion of his sophomore season, he transferred to [[Wichita State University]].{{Cite web |last=Eldridge |first=Taylor |title=Wichita State basketball dips back into transfer portal for team’s sixth 2022 recruit |url=https://www.kansas.com/sports/college/wichita-state/article260958702.html |website=Wichita Eagle}} As a junior, he averaged 10.6 points per game before entering the transfer portal for a second time.{{Cite web |last=Eldridge |first=Taylor |title=With Jaron Pierre in transfer portal, Wichita State must replace entire starting lineup |url=https://www.kansas.com/sports/college/wichita-state/article274270925.html |website=Wichita Eagle}} Pierre transferred to [[Jacksonville State University]], where he redshirted for a season before making an instant impact at the beginning of the [[2024–25 Jacksonville State Gamecocks men's basketball team|2024–25 season]].{{Cite web |last=Ashworth |first=Thomas |date=2024-11-19 |title=Jax State guard Jaron Pierre Jr. earns conference, national weekly honors |url=https://www.al.com/sports/2024/11/jax-state-guard-jaron-pierre-jr-earns-conference-national-weekly-honors.html |access-date=2025-03-10 |website=al |language=en}} Against Middle Tennessee State, he scored a career-high 36 points, setting the school record for most points scored in a game at home.{{Cite web |last=Medley |first=Joe |date=2025-02-07 |title=Jacksonville State University's 'Special Player' |url=https://calhounjournal.com/jacksonville-state-universitys-special-player/ |access-date=2025-03-10 |website=Calhoun Journal |language=en-US}} At the conclusion of the season, Pierre was named [[Conference USA Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Conference USA Player of the Year]].{{Cite web |last=Ashworth |first=Thomas |date=2025-03-10 |title=Jax State's Harper named CUSA Coach of Year, Pierre named player of the year |url=https://www.al.com/sports/2025/03/jax-states-harper-named-cusa-coach-of-year-pierre-named-player-of-the-year.html |access-date=2025-03-10 |website=al |language=en}}{{Cite web |author=Staff
